evidence: The report is on 0.80.1.0 and concerns only the original Mouse Without Borders UI.

judgment.recommended_action: Treat adding support as a product/policy decision; do not propose a persistence-only bug fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: The inspected integration explicitly marks this legacy setting unsupported. Enabling secure-desktop logo behavior and its policy support exceeds the reported save-toggle correction.
